31491533.headline: International Trainee - Hydro Power Optimisation and Data Analytics

description.text:
Company Description
Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes, and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.
Job Description
Shape the future of energy
Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives, and contribute to solving one of society’s most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall, and contribute to the energy transition from day one.
About the traineeship
This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each trainee position is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area, and working location. Each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges, and matching profile.
What you will experience
Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges
Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall’s different markets, business areas and locations through program activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration
Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives, and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm explains “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”
Your role as a Trainee Hydro Power Optimisation and Data Analytics Engineer
As a Hydro Power Optimisation and Data Analytics Engineer Trainee, you will join Production Support, a specialist and development function that supports safe, efficient and flexible hydropower production through optimisation, data analysis, digital tools and common working methods.
You will work closely with optimisation and development engineers, as well as colleagues in Production, Control Centres, Asset Management, IT and Markets. Together, you will turn operational and market-related needs into analyses, decision support and practical improvements for the operation of our generating units.
The role combines analytical problem-solving with hands-on development. You will use production and measurement data to evaluate performance, identify deviations and improvement opportunities, and contribute to the development of optimisation models, system services, forecasts, visualisations and data-driven working methods.
This is an opportunity to build broad expertise at the intersection of hydropower operations, energy markets, engineering and digitalisation, while contributing to increased flexibility, availability and long-term value from our hydropower assets.
Examples of your tasks and responsibilities:
Analyse production, operational and market-related data to identify trends, deviations and opportunities for improved performance
Support optimisation of generating units, water use and ancillary services through calculations, simulations and structured evaluation
Develop and improve analytical models, dashboards, visualisations and decision-support tools
Contribute to production analyses and technical studies for plant upgrades, operational changes and investment decisions
Work with data quality, measurement data and requirements for reliable and reusable data products.

Qualifications
Requirements for this trainee position
A Master of Science in Engineering or equivalent degree in a relevant field, such as Energy Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science or Data Science
Knowledge of data analysis, statistics, optimisation, modelling or simulation
Experience from programming or analytical tools, for example Python
Be fluent in Swedish and English; proficiency in additional languages is considered a merit.

You also recognize yourself in
You approach complex questions in a structured and analytical way, and can turn data into clear conclusions
You have an interest in optimisation, digital solutions, and how they create operational and business value
You are curious, proactive, and motivated to test new methods while maintaining quality and reliability
You enjoy collaborating across professional boundaries, and can communicate technical findings to different audiences
You take responsibility, share knowledge, and are motivated by creating practical improvements for the business
You are motivated to combine engineering knowledge, data and collaboration to improve hydropower production.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.
As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”
To be considered for Vattenfall’s trainee programme, you should:
Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the program starts in March 2027
Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
Be available for the full-time program from its start date 
Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
Be open to mobility opportunities, and collaboration across different locations 
Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive, and Safe.

Additional Information
Location
This position is located in Luleå, Sweden. You will work within Production Support in Business Unit Hydro Nordics.
Our offer 
“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve."

description.text:
Vill du göra komplex data begriplig och skapa insikter som driver verksamheten framåt? Som Analytics Engineer utvecklar du dataprodukter som hjälper människor och agentisk AI att fatta bättre beslut.

Den hållbara omställningen börjar med oss

Vi står inför vår största utmaning hittills – att se till att Sverige och Europa har det som krävs för att ställa om. Så att vi kan leva det liv vi vill, nu och imorgon. På samma sätt som vi vill förbättra framtiden, vill vi utveckla alla som är med oss på resan, personligt och professionellt. Vill du vara med och lägga grunden för det liv vi lever och som bygger världen omkring oss?

Din roll

Som Analytics Engineer i sektionen Data, Analytics & AI får du en central roll i vår satsning på att göra data tillgänglig och användbar. Du bygger semantiska modeller som gör data begriplig för både människor och AI-agenter och utvecklar dataprodukter som skapar värde i verksamheten. I sektionen samlas kompetens inom Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering samt Data Science och AI/Machine Learning, vilket ger stora möjligheter till samarbete och kunskapsutbyte. Rollen ligger i gränslandet mellan data engineering och analys, där fokus ligger på att skapa långsiktiga och skalbara lösningar snarare än enskilda rapporter.

Du kommer bland annat att:

Bygga semantiska modeller som gör data begriplig för både människor och AI-agenter
Utveckla dataprodukter med hjälp av AI, såsom rapporter, dashboards och nya sätt att konsumera data
Vidareutveckla analys- och rapportlagret i vår moderna dataplattform
Bidra till utvecklingen av agentiska AI-lösningar och datadrivna arbetssättUtforska och tillämpa nya teknologier inom data, analys och AI


Du arbetar nära verksamheten och tillsammans med ett erfaret team som har ett helhetsperspektiv på data. Vi utvecklar kontinuerligt våra arbetssätt och vår plattform för att möta framtidens behov, vilket ger dig möjlighet att vara med och forma hur data och AI används i organisationen.

Det här har du med dig

Du är en nyfiken och strukturerad person som trivs i samarbeten och gillar att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till användbara lösningar. Du håller dig uppdaterad kring ny teknik, AI och nya arbetssätt, och motiveras av att göra data mer tillgänglig, begriplig och värdeskapande för olika målgrupper. Du tar ansvar för dina leveranser, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till teamets gemensamma utveckling.

Vidare har du:

Utbildning inom data/IT eller motsvarande erfarenhetGoda kunskaper i SQL, datamodellering och semantiska modeller
Erfarenhet av att utveckla rapporter, dashboards och andra dataprodukter i verktyg som Power BI
Kunskap om CI/CD, versionshantering och hantering av miljöer
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
B-körkort


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av något av följande:

Praktisk erfarenhet av AI‑assisterad utveckling och intresse för agentisk AI
Erfarenhet av datalager, ETL/ELT eller Python
Kunskap om säker datahantering och informationssäkerhet
Erfarenhet av molnplattformar och moderna, säkra dataarkitekturer


Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!​

Vi strävar efter en rättvis och objektiv rekryteringsprocess. Därför ber vi vanligtvis inte om personliga brev. I stället ber vi dig att svara på frågor relaterat till den specifika tjänsten du söker. Dina svar hjälper oss att förstå din kompetens och erfarenhet, så ta dig tid att svara så tydligt och utförligt som möjligt.

Ansökningar behandlas löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Start: Enligt överenskommelse.

Plats: Kiruna Gällivare, eller Luleå

Omfattning: Heltid, dagtid

Kontakt: För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Daniel Nordvall, daniel.nordvall@lkab.com, 072 707 6701

Fackliga kontakter Kiruna/ Svappavaara:

Sakari Alanko, Unionen, 0980-725 08
Ledarna Norra, ledarna.norra@lkab.com
Peter Johansson, Akademikerföreningen, 0980-718 79


Fackliga kontakter Malmberget/Luleå:

LKAB är en internationell gruv- och mineralkoncern med norra Sverige som bas och hela världen som arbetsplats. Vileder vägen mot koldioxidfri produktion och vi gör det tillsammans – i en öppen, varm och säker arbetsmiljö medteknologi och utveckling i fokus. Vi välkomnar utmaningar, innovativa idéer och initiativförmåga, alltid medjämställdhet och mångfald i fokus.

description.text:
Vill du göra komplex data begriplig och skapa insikter som driver verksamheten framåt? Som Analytics Engineer utvecklar du dataprodukter som hjälper människor och agentisk AI att fatta bättre beslut.

Den hållbara omställningen börjar med oss

Vi står inför vår största utmaning hittills – att se till att Sverige och Europa har det som krävs för att ställa om. Så att vi kan leva det liv vi vill, nu och imorgon. På samma sätt som vi vill förbättra framtiden, vill vi utveckla alla som är med oss på resan, personligt och professionellt. Vill du vara med och lägga grunden för det liv vi lever och som bygger världen omkring oss?

Din roll

Som Analytics Engineer i sektionen Data, Analytics & AI får du en central roll i vår satsning på att göra data tillgänglig och användbar. Du bygger semantiska modeller som gör data begriplig för både människor och AI-agenter och utvecklar dataprodukter som skapar värde i verksamheten. I sektionen samlas kompetens inom Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering samt Data Science och AI/Machine Learning, vilket ger stora möjligheter till samarbete och kunskapsutbyte. Rollen ligger i gränslandet mellan data engineering och analys, där fokus ligger på att skapa långsiktiga och skalbara lösningar snarare än enskilda rapporter.

Du kommer bland annat att:

Bygga semantiska modeller som gör data begriplig för både människor och AI-agenter
Utveckla dataprodukter med hjälp av AI, såsom rapporter, dashboards och nya sätt att konsumera data
Vidareutveckla analys- och rapportlagret i vår moderna dataplattform
Bidra till utvecklingen av agentiska AI-lösningar och datadrivna arbetssättUtforska och tillämpa nya teknologier inom data, analys och AI


Du arbetar nära verksamheten och tillsammans med ett erfaret team som har ett helhetsperspektiv på data. Vi utvecklar kontinuerligt våra arbetssätt och vår plattform för att möta framtidens behov, vilket ger dig möjlighet att vara med och forma hur data och AI används i organisationen.

Det här har du med dig

Du är en nyfiken och strukturerad person som trivs i samarbeten och gillar att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till användbara lösningar. Du håller dig uppdaterad kring ny teknik, AI och nya arbetssätt, och motiveras av att göra data mer tillgänglig, begriplig och värdeskapande för olika målgrupper. Du tar ansvar för dina leveranser, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till teamets gemensamma utveckling.

Vidare har du:

Utbildning inom data/IT eller motsvarande erfarenhetGoda kunskaper i SQL, datamodellering och semantiska modeller
Erfarenhet av att utveckla rapporter, dashboards och andra dataprodukter i verktyg som Power BI
Kunskap om CI/CD, versionshantering och hantering av miljöer
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
B-körkort


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av något av följande:

Praktisk erfarenhet av AI‑assisterad utveckling och intresse för agentisk AI
Erfarenhet av datalager, ETL/ELT eller Python
Kunskap om säker datahantering och informationssäkerhet
Erfarenhet av molnplattformar och moderna, säkra dataarkitekturer


Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!​

Vi strävar efter en rättvis och objektiv rekryteringsprocess. Därför ber vi vanligtvis inte om personliga brev. I stället ber vi dig att svara på frågor relaterat till den specifika tjänsten du söker. Dina svar hjälper oss att förstå din kompetens och erfarenhet, så ta dig tid att svara så tydligt och utförligt som möjligt.

Ansökningar behandlas löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Plats: Kiruna Gällivare, eller Luleå

Omfattning: Heltid, dagtid

description.text:
Analytics Engineer
Stockholm or Munich | Full-time 
The Role:
As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.
As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.


Who you are:
A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions.
Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more.
Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly.
A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar.



Qualifications 
We are looking for someone with:
A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions).
Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines.
Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work.
Fluency in written and spoken English (business level).
Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design.



Nice to have:
Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on.



What you will do:
You will join the cross-functional data team responsible for Netlight's data platform, enabling decentralized analytics across the organisation. Your key focus areas will be:
Data Modeling & Quality: Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics, business intelligence, and AI use cases. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics. Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools, and build robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.
Governance & Enablement: Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants). Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need. Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership).
Optimization & Agile Delivery: Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability. Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles. Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what is genuinely useful.



What we offer:
The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
Mental health & parental support offerings
30 days of paid vacation.



Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:
5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
Private pension savings

Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:
Deutschlandticket
Wellpass



About us
Netlight is a global consulting company, turning complex needs into practical, real changes.


Come work with us
You will join a company built around personal responsibility, collaboration, and continuous learning. Different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make that possible, and we welcome applicants of all identities.


Apply today
This is a full-time role based in Stockholm or Munich, with a start date as soon as possible. Please read the required qualifications carefully: fluency in English is essential.
Send us your current CV in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or any repositories are welcome. If your profile looks like a match, you will hear from us within two weeks of applying. We look forward to hearing from you.

description.text:
Arbetsbeskrivning
Som Senior AI Engineer får du en nyckelroll i utvecklingen av vår strategiska AI-plattform. Du kombinerar hands-on programmering med ansvar för arkitektur, tekniska vägval och genomförande av AI-initiativ. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med utvecklare, Data Scientists och produktledare för att omsätta affärsbehov till skalbara lösningar som skapar konkret nytta.
Tjänsten tillhör IT-organisationen, rapporterar till Head of Architecture & Integration och erbjuder ett flexibelt hybridupplägg från något av våra kontor i Sverige.



Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, pragmatisk och tekniskt driven. Du är en problemlösare som trivs i samarbetet mellan teknik och verksamhet och motiveras av att bygga lösningar som skapar riktigt värde.

Ansvarsområden
Utveckla, driftsätta och underhålla AI-lösningar med fokus på Python, backend och API-integrationer.
Bygga lösningar inom generativ AI, såsom AI-agenter, RAG-arkitekturer och LLM-applikationer.
Bidra till arkitektur, säkerhet och den långsiktiga utvecklingen av koncernens AI-plattform.
Omvärldsbevaka AI-området och driva kontinuerliga förbättringsinitiativ.

Kvalifikationer
Minst ~5 års erfarenhet av AI-utveckling samt goda kunskaper i Python.
Erfarenhet av att driftsätta AI-lösningar i produktionsmiljö (LLM, RAG, embeddings, AI-agenter).
Erfarenhet av API-utveckling, integrationer, Git och CI/CD.
Förmåga att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar.
Flytande i svenska och engelska.

Meriterande: Erfarenhet av Azure AI Services/OpenAI, Databricks, Kubernetes, Terraform, LangChain eller LangGraph.

Om företaget

Randstad
På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential. 
Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

description.text:
Vi söker en AI Engineer som vill bygga lösningar som faktiskt används i verksamheten. För dig är AI inte en demo vid sidan av, utan ett verktyg för att lösa riktiga problem, automatisera arbete och skapa bättre sätt att jobba.

Du gillar att bygga, testa och få saker i produktion. Hos oss arbetar du nära både kunden och tekniken och behöver därför vara lika nyfiken på problemet som på modellen, arkitekturen eller verktyget som kan lösa det.

Vad du kommer att göra

Du kommer bland annat att:

designa, bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar med generativ AI, LLM:er, agents och automation
koppla AI till affärssystem, dataplattformar, API:er och andra verksamhetskritiska system
välja rätt angreppssätt för exempelvis retrieval, tool use och agentbaserade flöden
ta lösningar från idé och proof of concept till robust implementation och produktion
arbeta med utvärdering, testning, säkerhet, behörigheter och spårbarhet
samarbeta nära kunder för att förstå processer, data och behov och omsätta dem till fungerande lösningar


Vem vi tror att du är

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet inom systemutveckling, data, AI eller liknande och har byggt moderna AI-lösningar i praktiken.

Du behöver inte komma från klassisk machine learning eller forskning. Det viktiga är att du kan bygga fungerande produkter, integrationer och automationer och förstår vad som krävs för att få dem att fungera utanför en demo.

Vi tror också att du:

är en stark utvecklare och känner dig hemma i exempelvis Python, TypeScript, C# eller liknande
har erfarenhet av LLM-baserade lösningar och hur de kopplas till data, verktyg och externa system
är van vid API:er, integrationer och moderna moln- och utvecklingsmiljöer
förstår hur AI kan kopplas till ERP-miljöer som SAP, datalager och andra affärssystem
kan resonera kring säkerhet, behörigheter och dataskydd

description.text:
TL;DR
We're looking for a founding AI Engineer to help build the AI colleague every sales professional wishes they had. You'll own the agent stack end-to-end - from model selection to database (knowledge graph) structure and search algorithm development. Must be curious, experimental, and obsessed with agentic systems.
Why join
We’re a small, talent-dense team of engineers building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value speed, rigour, and extreme ownership. If you're obsessed with product, thrive in ambiguity, and want to push the edge of what agents can do, you’ll feel at home.
You’ll work on pushing the cutting edge in the agentic stack - including LLM fine-tuning, knowledge graphs, memory, orchestration, and intelligent retrieval. Not another chatbot.
We're backed by founders and operators behind Lovable, OpenAI, Tandem Health, and Neo4j. Our customers across 10 countries report 90% less prospecting time, 3x market coverage, and 2x customer meetings.
What you'll do (responsibilities)
In one sentence: Build the next generation agentic system.
Design and build agentic workflows powered by LLMs, vector search, and knowledge graphs
Build autonomous background agents that run real revenue workflows — triggered by schedules and CRM events, working across email, CRM, and the web
Own the agent stack end-to-end: from infrastructure to product logic
Ship fast: test ideas, run experiments, iterate daily
Shape the product, the stack, and the culture from the ground up

Who you are
Cracked engineer obsessed with building great software
Comfortable with ambiguity, early-stage chaos, and fast iteration
Thrive on new tech - LLMs, knowledge graphs, agents, you name it
Care more about solving problems than polishing abstractions
Fully committed to the mission: not "just a job"

What we offer
A team of obsessed engineers, full of speed, rigour, and grit
Mission-driven, no-BS culture: experiment, ship, learn
Meaningful equity through qualified employee stock options (QESO) from day one
Fully on-site in Stockholm - we believe in working together
Top-tier compensation package

Our stack
Frontend: React
Backend: Typescript, Node.js, Express, Neo4j, PostgreSQL
Agent: Typescript, LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), Mastra

About Spiich Labs
Spiich is the agentic platform for sales teams. Reps focus on the human work — building relationships, building trust, and closing deals — while Spiich agents handle everything else: prospecting, lead generation, CRM updates, meeting prep, follow-ups, and everything in between. The system integrates knowledge graphs, memory, and agentic workflows to deliver real help - not just summarisation or search. We're backed by founders and operators behind Lovable, OpenAI, Tandem Health, and Neo4j.
How we hire
Submit your application
Intro call with the team
Technical interview
Take-home exercise
Join us for trial work lasting 2 days on-site. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Spiich feels right for you.

We move fast — the full process typically takes under two weeks.
How to Apply
Drop us a line at filip@spiich.ai with your GitHub/LinkedIn, a note on why this excites you, and your proudest achievement. No CV needed.

description.text:
Vi söker en Project Manager som vill leda förändring där verksamhet, affärssystem och ny teknik möts. För dig handlar projektledning inte bara om planer och deadlines, utan om att förstå vad som behöver förändras och få människor, teknik och beslut att dra åt samma håll.

Du gillar att skapa struktur i komplexa sammanhang och röra dig mellan verksamheten och tekniska team. Hos oss kan projekten handla om AI, ERP och affärssystem, integrationer, automation eller andra digitala förändringar.

Vad du kommer att göra

Du kommer bland annat att:

leda projekt från förstudie och behovsanalys till implementation och uppföljning
skapa struktur kring mål, scope, plan, budget, risker, beroenden och beslut
leda workshops och hjälpa verksamheten att konkretisera behov och målbild
översätta mellan verksamhet, IT, utvecklingsteam, leverantörer och andra intressenter
arbeta nära tekniska team och förstå hur system, data, processer och integrationer påverkar leveransen
koordinera test, införande, förändring och övergång till förvaltning när det behövs
skapa tydliga beslutsunderlag och kommunicera framdrift, risker och vägval
utmana krav och arbetssätt när det finns ett bättre sätt att nå målet


Vem vi tror att du är

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet av projektledning, verksamhetsutveckling eller digital transformation och har lett initiativ där verksamhet och IT behöver fungera tillsammans.

Du behöver inte vara SAP-konsult, utvecklare eller AI Engineer. Däremot är du tekniskt nyfiken, kan snabbt sätta dig in i nya systemmiljöer och är bekväm med att arbeta nära både verksamheten och de som bygger lösningen.

Vi tror också att du:

har drivit IT-, system- eller transformationsprojekt från behov till genomförande
är van vid krav, processer, workshops och intressenthantering
förstår grunderna i affärssystem, integrationer och data
kan växla mellan helhet och detaljer och själv ta tag i analys eller krav när det behövs
förstår att införande av ny teknik också handlar om människor, arbetssätt och förändring
har börjat använda AI som ett naturligt verktyg i ditt eget arbete
är tydlig, prestigelös och trygg i dialog med både projektteam och beslutsfattare
driver saker framåt utan att behöva bli detaljstyrd
kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ERP- eller affärssystemsprojekt, SAP, AI-initiativ, automation, integrationer, systemimplementationer eller större förändringsprogram.

Det viktiga är inte vilken projektmodell du föredrar eller hur många certifieringar du har. Vi lägger större vikt vid att du kan förstå problemet, skapa förtroende och driva en komplex leverans hela vägen fram.

Varför Norrminds?

Du börjar inte på Norrminds bara för att få ett nytt jobb.

Vi bygger ett bolag där människor med olika styrkor får stort ansvar, kan påverka hur vi arbetar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vi tror på modet att testa gränser, på att göra saker tillsammans och på att teknik ska skapa nytta, inte bara mer teknik.

Vi arbetar i gränslandet mellan AI, affärssystem, integration och automation. Som Project Manager får du arbeta nära både tekniken och verksamheten och vara med där idéer blir till lösningar och nya arbetssätt.

Rollen kan utgå från Malmö, Linköping eller Stockholm. I dessa städer vill vi bygga något långsiktigt, så du ska tycka om tanken på att vara nära både kunder och framtida kollegor och vara med och forma Norrminds lokalt.

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

description.text:
The role
You’ll work within the AI team reporting to the AI & Innovation Lead. You will be primarily supporting R&D and Solutions but collaborating with all teams, to embed AI into Prover’s engineering workflows and help shape our next generation of AI-powered products, initially for railway signaling, and over time for safety-critical systems more broadly.
You will:
Build AI agents and assistants that accelerate formal verification and engineering workflows
Evaluate and integrate agent SDKs (e.g., Anthropic Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar) to build our own internal AI platform
Prototype AI-powered features for Prover Station, our digital twin and formal verification platform
Explore how LLMs can accelerate the adoption of formal methods in safety-critical domains

What we’re looking for
A hands-on builder who has shipped tools or prototypes using LLMs or AI agents, professionally, inside projects, or in open source
Deeply curious about AI and the fast-moving landscape of agent frameworks and developer tooling
Comfortable across the stack. We care more about builder mindset than a specific language or framework
Strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with domain experts in formal methods and signaling
Motivated by impact. Rail is one of the most energy-efficient modes of transport, and that matters to you

Nice to have:
Experience with agent SDKs and platforms
Familiarity with formal methods such as formal logic, formal specification, model checking, proof-oriented programming, and theorem proving
Experience building internal developer tools or platforms
Interest in domain-specific languages and how AI can make them more accessible

description.text:
Graduate AI Engineer – ADAS AI Agents
Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and the future of automotive technology? Do you want to help shape the next generation of connected, autonomous, and electric vehicles?
DXC Luxoft is a global leader in software engineering and digital transformation, partnering with many of the world's leading automotive manufacturers and suppliers. We are now looking for a talented and motivated Graduate AI Engineer to join our growing Automotive team in Sweden.
In this role, you will work at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), developing innovative AI agents and intelligent tools that support the creation of safer, smarter vehicles. You will collaborate with experienced automotive and AI engineers, apply cutting-edge technologies such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models, and contribute to real-world solutions for the mobility challenges of tomorrow.
This is an exciting opportunity for recent graduates and early-career professionals who are eager to combine their technical skills with creativity, innovation, and a passion for automotive technology. If you are looking for a role where you can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact in a fast-moving global environment, we would love to hear from you.
Join DXC Luxoft and help drive the future of intelligent mobility.
Project Description:
DXC Luxoft is a leading global software services company, delivering professional services across multiple business verticals such as finance, automotive, and digital transformation. The Automotive practice inside DXC Luxoft delivers software projects to a majority of the world's car manufacturers and suppliers for both personal and commercial vehicles. We are known for our Automotive software expertise and for helping our customers with high quality services and deliveries. Currently we are growing for our Swedish customers and are looking for Automotive cloud engineer with knowledge in cloud infrastructure development to join our team. You will be part of our growing organization in Sweden and will be part of developing next generation systems for the Automotive industry in the era of connected, autonomous, electric vehicles.


Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain C++ software for automotive systems with a strong focus on system safety
Candidates who can support in development of component adhering to functional safety standards
Contribute to system analysis, and implementation in compliance with automotive standards
Collaborate with hardware, software, and system teams across the development lifecycle
Develop and evaluate AI agents for automotive and ADAS use cases.
Build AI-powered tools to improve engineering productivity.
Apply Machine Learning and Generative AI techniques to ADAS challenges.
Work with ADAS engineers to prototype and deploy AI solutions.
Analyze automotive datasets and support AI model development.
Participate in research and innovation activities related to AI in automotive systems.
Mandatory Skills Description:
Hard skills:
- Degree in Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with MSc or BSc preferred in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Robotics, or Computer Vision.
- Experience in C++ software development within automotive settings.
- Foundational knowledge of AI and Machine Learning principles.
- Python programming.
- Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI concepts.
- Competence in data analysis to support problem-solving efforts.
Soft skills:
- Demonstrated leadership capabilities and effective communication skills.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
- Proven track record in automotive software development projects
Nice-to-Have Skills Description:
- ADAS knowledge: Familiarity with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems concepts and applications.
- Computer Vision: Understanding of image processing and visual data interpretation techniques.
- Deep Learning (PyTorch/TensorFlow): Experience with deep learning frameworks used for modeling and training AI systems.
- Master's Thesis related to ADAS, AI, Autonomous Driving, or Computer Vision: Relevant academic research demonstrating specialized expertise in these areas.
- Experience with AI Agent frameworks: Exposure to frameworks that facilitate the development of intelligent autonomous agents.
- Experience in agile or scaled agile environments: Optional familiarity with iterative and collaborative development methodologies.

description.text:
GlobalLogic is looking for a Data & AI Engineer to join an innovative team working at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, data analytics, and automotive software verification.
The team is developing an AI-based Measurement Analytics Tool designed to unlock insights from the large volumes of measurement data generated during vehicle software testing. The solution will help engineering teams reconstruct tests from measurement data, identify usage patterns, detect abnormal behaviour, analyse faults, and generate test and fault reports more efficiently.
This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career engineer who has strong Python fundamentals, an interest in AI/ML, and a passion for solving real-world engineering problems.
You will work alongside experienced software and test engineers and automotive domain experts, gaining hands-on exposure to vehicle systems, measurement data, diagnostic logs and modern AI technologies.
Job Responsibilities
AI/ML Development Support: Assist with the development, testing, and documentation of AI/ML components and data-processing pipelines for automotive measurement data.
Data Cleaning & Analysis: Parse, clean, structure, and analyse numerical telemetry, vehicle signals, diagnostic logs, and other measurement data.
Test Data Analytics: Support the identification of predefined test patterns within vehicle measurement data and generate test results and coverage analysis.
Machine Learning & Prototyping: Implement and evaluate basic analytical models, including time-series analysis, classification, clustering, and anomaly detection.
AI/LLM Support: Assist with developing and testing AI/LLM-based assistants, including prompt engineering and evaluation of AI-generated responses for test analysis.
User Journey Analysis: Analyse historical vehicle usage data to identify patterns and support the generation of representative/synthetic user journeys.
Python Development: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented Python code for data processing, analytics, and automation.
API & UI Development: Assist in developing simple APIs and web-based interfaces to expose data analytics and AI capabilities.
Technical Collaboration: Work closely with senior engineers and automotive domain experts to understand requirements, learn vehicle systems, and implement solutions under guidance.
Documentation: Document technical solutions, analysis results, experiments, and developed components.



Requirements:
Master’s degree in Data Science or Artificial Intelligence
Solid foundational programming skills in Python.
Ability to write Python scripts to parse, filter, transform, and analyse raw data such as CSV files, text files, logs, and telemetry data.
Familiarity with Python data-analysis libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software development principles.
Proficient in Computer Vision, OpenCV, Image Classification, Object Detection, TensorFlow, PyTorch and Tableau
Exposure to machine learning fundamentals, such as time-series analysis, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, or introductory NLP.
Skilled in Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering.
Familiarity with Git/version control is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
High curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and complex technical domains.
Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior engineers and domain experts.

description.text:
We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer
Join us in transforming the digital signage landscape. PLAYipp, the leading Nordic digital signage company, is seeking a senior engineer to own features end-to-end — from PRD to Production — which increasingly include building AI capabilities directly into our product. At PLAYipp, we don't write code by hand — everything is built by directing AI coding tools (we use Claude Code), and you're fully accountable for what ships, however it was written. You'll be working in a Team, alongside Product and fellow Engineers — each of you carrying a bigger slice of the work than in a traditional setup, but never working alone.
About PLAYipp
At PLAYipp, we deliver comprehensive, user-friendly digital signage solutions that empower businesses to communicate effectively and innovate. Our platform enables organizations of all sizes to manage and showcase content seamlessly across various screens, enhancing communication and customer engagement.
We're also at the forefront of how software gets built, constantly pushing for new ways to work more efficiently with AI without ever compromising on code quality. If you like being at that edge, this is the place.
Key role description
You own features end-to-end: front end, back end, testing, and the architecture decisions along the way. You're never on your own with this — your team, our chief architect, and our Head of AI are there to support you whenever you need it.
Beyond product features, you'll also help build AI into how the whole organization works — tools that let AI handle work that used to require an engineer.
What we expect from you
Building, Testing & Maintaining the Product

Take requirements from PRD to finished, deployed feature.


Write and maintain tests as part of building — quality is your responsibility.


Ownership — you ship it, you're responsible for it in production.


Think about scalability and architecture, together with our Chief Architect, as a natural part of building, not an afterthought.


Building AI Into the Product

Build AI-powered capabilities into the PLAYipp product itself.


Work with LLM APIs and related tooling to get these features to production, not just prototypes.


Internal AI Enablement

Occasionally build internal tooling that helps the wider organization become more self-sufficient with AI — e.g. giving non-engineers direct, self-serve access to data that used to require an engineer.


Bring in new AI tools and workflows as they prove useful, and keep pushing for more efficient ways to work with AI without compromising quality.


Team Collaboration & attitude

Share knowledge — on architecture, testing, deployment, and AI tooling — through documentation and workshops.


Help team members grow their technical skills, including AI-assisted development.


Lead by example in communication, drive and creativity.


Foster a collaborative, learning-oriented team culture.

Required CompetenciesTechnical Skills
7+ years of professional experience in full-stack development, with demonstrated progression in technical complexity and responsibility.


Practical experience building AI/LLM-powered features in a production product.


Strong expertise in TypeScript, React, and Node.js — enough to review, judge, and be fully accountable for AI-generated code. Even though AI writes it, you own every line and are the one who fixes it when it breaks.


Deep understanding of modern web application architecture, including RESTful APIs.


Proficient with relational databases (MySQL or similar), including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.


You shouldn't have been coding manually for some time; Claude Code experience specifically isn't required, but AI-directed development should already be how you work.


Comfortable with ownership, not just writing code and passing it along.


Nimble and adaptable — comfortable moving between product feature work and internal tooling/enablement work as priorities shift.

Location & Schedule
Hybrid but primarily based, 3 days/week minimum, at PLAYipp HQ in central Gävle.


Core collaboration hours for team synchronization.

Why Join PLAYipp?
Work with a talented and enthusiastic team in an innovative and growing company.


Shape how AI gets built into a market-leading product, not just talk about it.


Be part of a small, tight-knit team where you carry real ownership — without working alone.


Enjoy a dynamic and collaborative work environment that values creativity and initiative.


Opportunity to make a significant impact on the digital signage industry.


Competitive salary and benefits package.


If you're ready to build the future of digital signage with AI at the core of how you work, apply today.
Locations: PLAYipp HQ Gävle Remote status: Hybrid

description.text:
Nordic Investin has been engaged by a partner company to find a Senior Generative AI Engineer. You want to build generative AI systems that are useful because retrieval, evaluation, permissions and workflow design are treated as engineering problems.
The partner is developing AI assisted capabilities for knowledge intensive work. You will create production applications around language models, test their behaviour and connect them safely to enterprise data and tools.
The partner wants data and AI work that can be operated, explained and improved after launch. Provenance, quality, access and evaluation belong in the solution from the beginning.
How you will work
You will work with engineers, analysts and domain specialists who look at the same information from different angles. The partner expects assumptions, datasets and evaluation methods to be visible. Solutions should be designed for repeatable delivery, monitored use and responsible change after deployment.
As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work.
What you will do
Design retrieval augmented generation and agent workflows.


Build evaluation suites for quality, safety and regression testing.


Integrate models with documents, APIs and business systems.


Implement identity, permission and audit controls.


Optimise latency, context use and operating cost.


Work with domain experts to define useful human review patterns.

What you will bring
Strong Python and backend engineering experience.


Hands on work with language model APIs and orchestration frameworks.


Knowledge of embeddings, retrieval and vector search.


Experience evaluating nondeterministic systems.


Cloud deployment, observability and security awareness.


Ability to challenge a use case when a simpler solution is better.

Experience that would add value
Fine tuning or model hosting.


Information retrieval or search engineering.


Enterprise knowledge management and document processing.

A background that can succeed here
You may come from NLP, search, backend engineering, data platforms or applied AI research. The partner is looking for production judgement rather than a collection of demos.
What makes the opportunity interesting
You will work on high interest technology with the discipline required for lasting value. The role provides direct access to users, complex information problems and room to shape the engineering standards for future AI products.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.
The recruitment conversation
During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

description.text:
About this role
Enterprise software is going through its biggest shift in decades. Applications are moving from deterministic workflows to intelligent, agentic systems that understand context, remember preferences, and act on behalf of users. This isn’t a future prediction — it’s happening now, and Columbus is building at the frontier of it.
We’re hiring three senior engineers to form the core of our Group AI engineering team. Together, you’ll design and build the next generation of AI-powered systems that will transform how thousands of people work — across the Nordics and beyond. You’ll work directly with the VP Group AI. No layers. No committees. You build, you ship, you learn.
This is not a consulting engagement or a proof-of-concept. It’s production engineering at enterprise scale, on the Microsoft platform, using the most advanced AI models available today.
 What you will bring
We are looking for someone who have/is

Strong expertise in LLM application design, including prompt engineering, agent frameworks, and evaluation


Good undetstanding of data as a foundation for AI driven Insights


Experience building scalable, production-grade AI systems, with focus on context management, cost optimization, and real-world deployment


Proven ability to design multi-agent architectures where AI systems collaborate effectively


Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Graph, Teams, SharePoint) and cloud-native platforms like Azure


Solid background in data and retrieval systems, including vector search, embeddings, document databases, and RAG architectures


Skilled in building robust, event-driven and API-based systems with strong focus on reliability, security, and enterprise compliance


 If you don't match all these qualification above but is an expert in either of the three, don't hesitate to apply:
AI Application You bring deep experience in LLM application architecture, including prompt engineering, agent frameworks, tool integration, and model evaluation. You have a strong understanding of context window management, cost optimisation, and model behaviour at scale, combined with expert knowledge of AI Security and AI Governance.
AI Automation & Integration You have hands-on experience with Microsoft Graph, Teams, SharePoint, and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem. In addition, you possess expert knowledge of AI Security and AI Governance as they relate to automation, integrations, and enterprise-scale AI solutions.
AI Infrastructure You bring extensive experience with document databases, vector search technologies, and embedding models. You understand RAG architectures, including chunking, reranking, hybrid search, and citation grounding, and can design data governance frameworks that meet enterprise compliance requirements such as DLP, auditing, and retention. You have experience building scalable knowledge retrieval systems, supported by expert knowledge of AI Security and AI Governance.
Application
At our company, you can easily apply using your LinkedIn profile or your CV, without having to fill out long questionnaires. You do not need to submit a cover letter.
In our recruitment process, we use logic and personality tests. We always check references and conduct a background check before an employment offer is made. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Daniel Sparrow. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
After the recruitment process has ended, we will ask you about your experience as a candidate. It only takes a few seconds to answer, and it helps us improve our recruitment process.
Working at Columbus
People always come first at Columbus. We are a global consulting firm with local presence, helping companies with their digital transformation and to thrive through technology, data, and human insight. We are also a workplace where you, as an employee, can develop your career and get support through clear and structured career paths.
Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to deliver value to our clients. Whether you’re experienced or just starting out in your career, you’ll find the freedom to explore ideas, challenge the familiar, and shape your own path with us.
With more than 1,500 colleagues in over 10 countries, we combine global perspectives with local understanding. What unites us is our belief in creating meaningful impact – for our employees, our clients, and the journey ahead.
Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together! ⭐

What others say about us
Interested in Columbus behind the scenes? Each week, we let a colleague take over our Instagram account.
At Careereye, current and former employees can share their unfiltered reviews about what it’s like to work with us. Click below to read their experiences.

description.text:
Vill du ta AI-lösningar från idé till säker och skalbar produktion? Vi söker en senior AI Engineer med kompetens på arkitektnivå och fokus på Microsoft Foundry. Rollen passar dig som kombinerar djup teknisk förståelse med förmågan att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till lösningar som skapar konkret nytta.
Om rollen
Du ansvarar för arkitektur och tekniskt genomförande av AI-lösningar på Microsofts plattform. Du arbetar genom hela livscykeln – från behovsanalys och teknikval till utveckling, utvärdering, driftsättning och vidareutveckling.
Det är en praktisk arkitektroll där du både fattar övergripande designbeslut och själv utvecklar kod. Du vägleder andra utvecklare och förklarar tekniska vägval för såväl verksamhet som IT.
Dina arbetsuppgifter
• Utforma lösningsarkitektur för AI-applikationer och agenter med Microsoft Foundry och Azure.
• Utveckla lösningar med språkmodeller, RAG, verktygsanrop och integrationer mot verksamhetssystem.
• Utforma informationsflöden, sökindex och behörighetsstyrd åtkomst till verksamhetsdata.
• Säkerställa kvalitet genom systematisk utvärdering av svar, agentbeteenden och modellval.
• Bygga in säkerhet och dataskydd samt hantera risker som promptinjektion och obehörig informationsåtkomst.
• Etablera arbetssätt för versionshantering, automatiserad driftsättning, övervakning och kostnadsuppföljning.
• Leda tekniska workshops, dokumentera arkitekturbeslut och stötta kollegor i implementationen.
Vi söker dig som
• Har gedigen erfarenhet av systemutveckling och lösningsarkitektur i Azure.
• Har praktisk erfarenhet av Microsoft Foundry eller Azure AI Foundry och av att utveckla lösningar med stora språkmodeller.
• Har tagit AI-lösningar till produktion och förstår kraven på tillförlitlighet, prestanda och förvaltning.
• Är trygg i Python och/eller C# samt API-utveckling och integrationer.
• Har erfarenhet av RAG, vektorsökning och söktjänster, exempelvis Azure AI Search.

description.text:
Generative AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how we work — and we are still only at the beginning.
At Husqvarna Group, we are looking for a Delivery Lead – GenAI Business Solutions who wants to help turn those possibilities into real impact. You will be at the center of how we explore, prioritize and scale GenAI across a global organization — connecting emerging technology with business needs, people and measurable value.
A key part of this journey will be working with our software development community to unlock the potential of AI-powered development tools and new ways of working.
About The Team
You will join Enterprise AI & Automation, part of GIS – Digital Business Transformation, where we work to enable and scale the use of AI and automation across Husqvarna Group.
Our work spans both internally developed AI solutions and third-party Generative AI technologies. Our GenAI ecosystem includes solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, Claude Code and Synthesia.
As the use of Generative AI grows across Husqvarna Group, our focus is on ensuring that these technologies are adopted responsibly, managed effectively and create real business value across the organization.
You will work closely with the other GenAI Delivery Lead, as well as stakeholders across business, technology, security and transformation.
About The Role
As Delivery Lead – GenAI Business Solutions, you will take the business-facing lead for Husqvarna Group’s portfolio of third-party Generative AI tools.
You will engage with teams and leaders across Husqvarna Group to understand their needs and identify where GenAI can improve productivity, collaboration, content creation and software development. Software development will be an important part of your scope, and you will work closely with developer teams to understand their needs and help enable the effective use of GenAI tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code.
A central part of the role is adoption and enablement. Together with Learning & Development and other stakeholders, you will drive workshops, training, communication and other initiatives that help employees understand and make effective use of GenAI.
You will also own strategic relationships with GenAI technology partners such as Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic and Synthesia. Together with Procurement and Finance, you will work with licensing, commercial discussions, renewals and optimization to ensure our technology investments deliver the expected value.
As the GenAI landscape continues to evolve, you will evaluate new capabilities and market offerings and help determine which opportunities are relevant for Husqvarna Group. Together with the Delivery Lead – GenAI Platforms & Governance, you will align business demand with licensing strategy, service design, governance and the future platform roadmap.
About You
You are a curious and business-oriented leader who understands how technology can create value for people and organizations.
You combine a solid understanding of the GenAI landscape with strong stakeholder and relationship-building skills. You are comfortable discussing technology and use cases without needing to be an AI engineer yourself.
You are comfortable working with software development organizations and understand the language, needs and ways of working of developer teams. You don't need to be a hands-on developer today.
You know how to create engagement around new technology, influence without formal authority and turn ideas into practical action. You are equally comfortable engaging senior leaders, facilitating workshops and working with vendors.
Your Skills And Background
8+ years of professional experience within IT, digital transformation, technology delivery or related environments.
Strong understanding of the Generative AI ecosystem and hands-on familiarity with tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or similar solutions.
Experience from software development environments or working closely with developer teams, with the ability to understand their requirements, language and ways of working.
Experience driving technology adoption, digital transformation, software rollouts or technology-enabled change.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to engage both business and technical stakeholders across functions and levels.
Experience identifying business needs and translating them into technology opportunities, priorities and initiatives.
Experience driving adoption and enablement through workshops, training and communication.
Experience working with technology vendors and external partners, ideally including licensing, commercial discussions, procurement or contract-related activities.
Ability to evaluate technology investments from a business value and value-realization perspective.
Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to make complex technology understandable and relevant to different audiences.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Experience working directly with enterprise GenAI tools or large-scale AI adoption is highly valued, but experience leading the adoption of other emerging technologies combined with strong GenAI knowledge is also relevant.
Location
This position will be based at one of our sites in Sweden: Huskvarna, Stockholm, or Jonsered.
How We Work
We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.
Your application
We look forward to receiving your application! Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the final application date 20 September.
For questions specifically related to the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Partner Victoria Kjellgren at victoria.kjellgren@husqvarnagroup.com.
Note: We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR compliance.

description.text:
Vill du vara med och bygga både plattformen och lösningarna som gör AI till en naturlig del av vardagen för medarbetare och kunder? Hos ATG får du kombinera teknisk spets inom AI, data och molnlösningar med möjligheten att påverka hur framtidens AI-förmågor utvecklas och används.I rollen får du:

Bygga och utveckla ATG:s AI-plattform för framtidens AI-lösningar.
Utveckla och produktionssätta GenAI-lösningar i AWS med tekniker som Bedrock och SageMaker.
Omvandla verksamhetens behov till konkreta AI-produkter.
Etablera arbetssätt och best practices inom AI, MLOps och LLMOps.
Arbeta genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från datainhämtning och integrationer till driftsättning och uppföljning.
Ta fram gemensamma komponenter och riktlinjer för skalbar och säker AI-utveckling.
Samarbeta med utvecklingsteam och verksamhet för att identifiera nya användningsområden för AI.


Du kommer att arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan data, plattform och produktutveckling med fokus på att skapa AI-lösningar som ger affärsnytta. Rollen kombinerar utveckling av den tekniska plattformen med framtagning av konkreta GenAI-produkter.Är det här du? Vi tror att du har en stark teknisk grund och ett stort intresse för hur AI kan användas för att lösa verkliga problem. Du trivs i en miljö där mycket är under uppbyggnad och där du får möjlighet att påverka teknikval, arbetssätt och framtida lösningar. Du är analytisk, kommunikativ och arbetar gärna tillsammans med både utvecklare, produktteam och verksamhet. Vi ser att du har:

Flera års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och mycket goda kunskaper i Python.
Erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera AI- eller GenAI-lösningar.
God kunskap inom AWS och erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar.
Erfarenhet av dataplattformar, dataflöden och integrationer.
Förståelse för eventdriven arkitektur och distribuerade system.
Erfarenhet av CI/CD, versionshantering och moderna utvecklingsprocesser.
Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform.
Kunskap inom MLOps och/eller LLMOps.
Erfarenhet av RAG-lösningar, MCP-arkitektur, AI-observability eller AI-utvärdering.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora datamängder.
Kunskap om säker datahantering och GDPR.
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.


Meriterande:Erfarenhet av Node.js.

Så här har vi detHos oss är du del av en innovativ miljö och med hjälp av den senaste tekniken utvecklar du den bästa spelupplevelsen. Vi gillar att samarbeta och hos oss får du stort utrymme att påverka ditt arbetssätt. Här hittar du nyfikna, nytänkande medarbetare och ledare – viktiga egenskaper för att kunna utveckla och utvecklas. Liksom energi , mod och motivation. ​

För att må bra är skrattmuskeln lika viktig att träna som alla andra muskler. Både den fysiska och den mentala hälsan skapar balans i livet. Hur vi har det på jobbet påverkar privatlivet- och vice versa. Vi ser det som en självklarhet att ge det stöd och de verktyg som behövs. ​ Ditt val av arbetsplats och arbetssätt är flexibelt och vi lägger stor vikt på självledarskap.​

Vi bryr oss om varandra och respekterar varandras olikheter på ATG. Och vi vill att våra kunder ska må bra och ha roligt när de spelar. Vi bryr oss också om sportens välmående, dvs. idrottarna och hästarna - och samhället runt omkring oss. Vi drivs inte av privata vinstintressen utan allt överskott går tillbaka till våra ägare, svensk trav- och galoppsport, något som både känns och gör gott.

description.text:
SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.
We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
A quick note: This is not a traditional hiring process. While we're not actively looking to fill an immediate vacancy, we're always interested in meeting exceptional people who can help shape SAVR's future. If there's a strong mutual fit, we're open to exploring opportunities together
The Role – AI Engineer
As an AI Engineer with backend skills in our cross-functional team, you’ll join our tech team in Stockholm or Halmstad to build AI-powered product experiences end-to-end. You’ll work closely with fellow Software Engineers, Product Designers, and Product Managers to ship LLM-driven features such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, intelligent assistants, and automation, built for reliability, security, and great UX.
Our Tech Team Lead will manage and support your work, while reporting directly to our VP of Engineering. A glimpse into our tech stack: Python, SQL, Terraform, hosted on AWS, plus an AI stack that includes LLM APIs/open-source models, vector databases/similarity search, retrieval pipelines, evaluation tooling, and observability for production AI.
Your Mission
Build and ship LLM-powered product features (RAG, assistants, semantic search).


Productionize AI systems with guardrails, monitoring, evals, and cost/latency control.


Partner with product/design/engineering to turn use cases into measurable outcomes.


Build and maintain key platform features, APIs, and services, prioritizing scalability, reliability, and top-tier performance.


Provide direction and strategic insight on data related topics.

Additionally you will
Drive ideas and develop concepts from a tech perspective.


Explore ideas iteratively and refine them into production-quality solutions.


Contribute to improving the architecture, tech stack, and operational methods.


Improve our AI development workflow to support safe and reliable production AI.


Follow and promote good engineering practices to deliver high-quality products.


Engage in code reviews and foster a culture of continuous learning through constructive feedback.


Be a positive force for our team culture.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You...
4+ years of professional team-based software development experience, with at least some experience building ML/AI-powered features or systems in production.


Experience working with scalable, product-based environments, where you’ve shipped user-facing features and care about latency, reliability, and real-world constraints.


Solid understanding of backend systems and data modeling, enough to build reliable text retrieval, integrate with existing services, and reason about data quality, privacy, and access control in AI workflows.


Passion for applied AI, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, LLM evaluation, fine-tuning, and model serving.


Strong collaboration skills and an open-minded approach to exchanging ideas.


Fluent in English and a team player who values diverse perspectives.


Swedish citizen or valid EU work permits (we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role).


We’re seeking a motivated engineer with a broad skill set and a passion for applied AI, especially LLM-powered products, retrieval, and production-grade AI systems. You are someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is eager to contribute to building something great.
Our Cultural DNA
At SAVR, we’re:

🧠 Open-minded – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning
🚀 Bold – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward
🤝 Honest – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing

We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.

The Role – AI Engineer

As an AI Engineer with backend skills in our cross-functional team, you’ll join our tech team in Stockholm or Halmstad to build AI-powered product experiences end-to-end. Our Tech Team Lead will manage and support your work, while reporting directly to our VP of Engineering. A glimpse into our tech stack: Python, SQL, Terraform, hosted on AWS, plus an AI stack that includes LLM APIs/open-source models, vector databases/similarity search, retrieval pipelines, evaluation tooling, and observability for production AI.

Your Mission

  • Productionize AI systems with guardrails, monitoring, evals, and cost/latency control.

  • Partner with product/design/engineering to turn use cases into measurable outcomes.

  • Solid understanding of backend systems and data modeling, enough to build reliable text retrieval, integrate with existing services, and reason about data quality, privacy, and access control in AI workflows.

  • Strong collaboration skills and an open-minded approach to exchanging ideas.

  • Swedish citizen or valid EU work permits (we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role).

description.text:
Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work. We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when teams can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments people - not replaces them.
We bring this mission to life through two products. Sana Agents provide a seamless way to access all your company’s apps, knowledge, and data, enabling AI agents to do real work so teams can process and act on information at unprecedented scale. Sana Learn is an AI-powered learning hub that combines the simplicity of a modern learning platform with intelligent features like an AI tutor, automated content generation, and interactive apps, making knowledge not just accessible but actionable.
We’re a talent-dense, product-obsessed team of engineers and designers from companies like Google, Spotify, Apple, and Databricks, united by deep technical excellence and rapid iteration. Our tools already help over a million people learn and work better across hundreds of leading enterprises - and we’re just getting started.
About the Role
You'll build the core agent infrastructure that powers Sana's mission to bring superintelligence to work. This is a greenfield opportunity to define how AI agents plan, reason, and execute across enterprise environments—building systems that reliably handle real-world complexity at scale. You'll work at the intersection of agent architecture, context-, tool- and prompt engineering, and production infrastructure.
In this role, you will
Architect multi-step planning, orchestration, and tool routing for agents
Implement code generation agents and sandboxed code execution
Engineer memory, state, and context packing/grounding strategies
Balance latency, quality, and cost controls for agent execution
Develop safe fallbacks, graceful degradation and robust error handling
Collaborate with platform and search teams to deliver reusable agent infrastructure
Establish safety guarantees and measurable quality improvements
About You
Basic Qualifications:
3+ years of software engineering experience building production backend or platform systems.
3+ years of experience in TypeScript, with a strong track record of writing reliable, maintainable services.
3+ years of experience with distributed systems, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and service-oriented architecture.
3+ years of experience designing systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, observability, and maintainability.
Other Qualifications:
Experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications in production.
Experience building agent platforms or AI infrastructure.
Deep understanding of the low-level details of the OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic LLM APIs, including tool calling, system prompt caching, etc.
Familiarity with LLM application patterns, including tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory and context management, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop systems.
Experience building and running machine learning systems in production, including compiling training and test datasets, building training pipelines, evaluating models, and detecting and handling drift (neural networks, Gaussian models, Thompson sampling, etc.).
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent quality and safety, including hands-on use of platforms such as Langfuse or LangSmith.
Familiarity with vector databases, prompt and context engineering, and experimentation tooling.
Experience working with sandbox environments such as Modal, and designing strict access control models to keep user data safe and encrypted at all times.
Experience running services in Kubernetes-based environments on GCP or equivalent cloud platforms.
Comfort working with Postgres and Redis in high-throughput, low-latency service contexts.
Contributions to open source TypeScript projects.
Ability to navigate ambiguity, make strong technical tradeoffs, and drive projects from concept to production.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, and AI research teams.

description.text:
AI förändrar hur företag utvecklar produkter, effektiviserar verksamheter och skapar nya affärsmöjligheter. På Knowit Solutions vill vi ligga i framkant – och nu söker vi en person som vill vara med och driva vår AI-utveckling, både internt och tillsammans med våra kunder.
Vi söker dig som kombinerar en stark teknisk bakgrund inom systemutveckling med praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga moderna AI-lösningar, framför allt inom generativ AI. Du trivs lika bra med att utveckla lösningar som att inspirera kollegor, hålla workshops och hjälpa kunder att hitta rätt väg framåt.
Hos oss blir du en central del av vår AI-satsning. Du kommer att stötta våra utvecklingsteam med kompetens och vägledning, bidra till att höja vår interna AI-mognad och vara en nyckelperson i dialogen med kunder. Samtidigt kommer du själv att arbeta i konsultuppdrag där du designar och utvecklar AI-lösningar som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.
I rollen kommer du att
Vara en drivande kraft i vår AI-satsning och bidra till att utveckla vårt erbjudande.


Stötta och coacha våra utvecklingsteam kring AI, generativ AI och moderna utvecklingsverktyg.


Hjälpa våra team att använda AI för ökad produktivitet och högre kvalitet i utvecklingen.


Designa och implementera AI-lösningar tillsammans med våra kunder.


Delta i kunddialoger och hjälpa kunder att identifiera hur AI kan skapa affärsnytta.


Planera och genomföra AI-workshops, inspirationssessioner och förstudier.


Hålla dig uppdaterad kring den snabba utvecklingen inom AI och omsätta nya möjligheter i praktiken.


Arbeta i konsultuppdrag med fokus på AI och modern systemutveckling.

Vi tror att du
Har flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling.


Har praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera AI-lösningar, gärna med fokus på generativ AI, LLM, RAG, AI-agenter och liknande tekniker.


Har god förståelse för hur AI integreras i moderna system och affärsprocesser.


Är bekväm med både kod, arkitektur och tekniska vägval.


Tycker om att dela med dig av kunskap och coacha andra utvecklare.


Är trygg i dialogen med kunder och kan förklara komplex teknik på ett tydligt och engagerande sätt.


Har ett konsultmässigt förhållningssätt och trivs med att skapa långsiktiga kundrelationer.


Är nyfiken, prestigelös och drivs av att utforska nya möjligheter.

Därför Knowit Solutions
Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och forma hur vi arbetar med AI – inte bara i våra kundprojekt utan också internt. Du får stor möjlighet att påverka våra arbetssätt, vår kompetensutveckling och vårt erbjudande samtidigt som du arbetar tillsammans med några av branschens mest kompetenta utvecklare.
Vi söker inte bara någon som vill bygga AI-lösningar. Vi söker någon som vill hjälpa både våra kunder och våra kollegor att lyckas med AI.
Ansökan
Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag, rekrytering sker löpande. Vi genomför även bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat. Har du frågor? Kontakta rekryteringsansvarig Carolina Jonsson carolina.m.jonsson@knowit.se
Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att  lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI,  cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting  utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.
Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions,  Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.We don’t wait for the future. We build it.
